instructions.text: Read the entire method first and measure the following ingredients before turning on the heat: 2 ripe bananas (250 g/9 oz peeled); 100g (3.5 oz) of oatmeal; 1 table spoon of cinnamon powder (optional); 1 table spoon of honey (optional). Keep ingredients marked optional separate until their step.

Prepare these ingredients before cooking: Bananas: ripe; 250 g/9 oz peeled. Wash produce under running water before cutting. Use a cutting board and a sharp knife; keep raw meat and its utensils separate from ready-to-eat ingredients.
Peel the bananas and squash them not too finely in a bowl.
On the oven tray, place parchment paper and form discs of the mix, each around 8 cm (3 in)
Cook with rotating heat for around 20 minutes, until outside becomes golden and slightly crispy.
Can be kept a couple of days in a sealed container.

Turn off any burners or oven when cooking is finished. Follow the cooling or resting instruction above before cutting or serving. Serve the finished dish as directed; allow hot portions to cool enough to eat.

source.author: Éric G.
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 180°C (350°F)
2. Peel the bananas and squash them not too finely in a bowl.
3. Incorporate the oatmeal.
4. Incorporate cinnamon powder and/or honey (optional).
5. On the oven tray, place parchment paper and form discs of the mix, each around 8 cm (3 in)
6. Cook with rotating heat for around 20 minutes, until outside becomes golden and slightly crispy.
7. Eat warm or cold. Can be kept a couple of days in a sealed container.
